SELECT ai.analyticsindicatorsnode, 
       ai.mdataref, ai.mstatsref,
       ai.market_sentiment_indicators->'flow'->>'smartforce' as smartforce,
       ai.market_sentiment_indicators->'flow'->>'retailflow' as retailflow,
       ai.market_sentiment_indicators->'flow'->>'instflow' as instflow,
       ai.market_sentiment_indicators->'big_players'->>'whalemotion' as whalemotion,
       md.quote_depth_snapshot->'metadata'->>'mktcombo' as mktcombo,
       ms.priceshiftday
FROM analyticsindicators ai
JOIN marketdata md ON ai.mdataref = md.marketdatanode
JOIN marketstats ms ON ai.mstatsref = ms.marketstatsmark
LIMIT 5;

WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT 
        ai.market_sentiment_indicators->'flow'->>'smartforce'::numeric as smartforce,
        ai.market_sentiment_indicators->'flow'->>'retailflow'::numeric as retailflow,
        ai.market_sentiment_indicators->'flow'->>'instflow'::numeric as instflow,
        ai.market_sentiment_indicators->'big_players'->>'whalemotion' as whalemotion,
        md.quote_depth_snapshot->'metadata'->>'mktcombo' as mktcombo,
        ms.priceshiftday as price_change_day,
        -- Smart Money Accuracy condition: direction matches price movement
        CASE 
            WHEN (ai.market_sentiment_indicators->'flow'->>'smartforce')::numeric > (ai.market_sentiment_indicators->'flow'->>'retailflow')::numeric 
                 AND (ai.market_sentiment_indicators->'flow'->>'smartforce')::numeric > (ai.market_sentiment_indicators->'flow'->>'instflow')::numeric 
                 AND ms.priceshiftday > 0 THEN 1
            WHEN (ai.market_sentiment_indicators->'flow'->>'smartforce')::numeric < (ai.market_sentiment_indicators->'flow'->>'retailflow')::numeric 
                 AND (ai.market_sentiment_indicators->'flow'->>'smartforce')::numeric < (ai.market_sentiment_indicators->'flow'->>'instflow')::numeric 
                 AND ms.priceshiftday < 0 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as accuracy_match
    FROM analyticsindicators ai
    JOIN marketdata md ON ai.mdataref = md.marketdatanode
    JOIN marketstats ms ON ai.mstatsref = ms.marketstatsmark
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN smartforce > retailflow * 1.2 AND smartforce > instflow * 1.2 THEN 'Smart Money Dominant'
        WHEN retailflow > smartforce * 1.2 AND retailflow > instflow * 1.2 THEN 'Retail Dominant'
        WHEN instflow > smartforce * 1.2 AND instflow > retailflow * 1.2 THEN 'Institutional Dominant'
        ELSE 'Mixed'
    END as flow_category,
    whalemotion as whale_activity_level,
    mktcombo as market_pair,
    ROUND(AVG(price_change_day), 4) as avg_price_change_24h,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(accuracy_match) AS numeric) / COUNT(*), 4) as smart_trading_success_rate
FROM base_data
GROUP BY flow_category, whalemotion, mktcombo
ORDER BY smart_trading_success_rate DESC;
